entries.title: Plans that include a month of AI use
entries.body: Each plan includes an amount of AI use that starts again every month. We warn you before you run out.

entries.title: Try the designer before you sign up
entries.body: Change the look of a sample page right on our home page. Nothing is kept, and no account is needed.

entries.title: See what your app does behind each page
entries.body: The emails it sends, the work it does on its own and the outside services it calls, page by page.

entries.title: Make email or another service fail on purpose
entries.body: Pick what goes wrong, then use your app as a visitor would. Nothing is really sent.

entries.title: Changes that break when sent twice are sent back
entries.body: A change that saves or sends something is tried with a form sent twice and with failed emails. A change that leaves half its work behind does not reach you.

entries.title: Changes to records are tried by strangers first
entries.body: A change that touches a record is tried by someone signed out and by someone it does not belong to, such as a person outside the team. A change that lets them in is sent back.

entries.title: Watch the AI think while it works
entries.body: You see each step in plain words, and each check as it runs, not a spinner.

entries.title: We say whose fault it is
entries.body: When a change cannot be made, we say why and what to do. When it is our fault, we say so.

entries.title: Share a link so others can try your app
entries.body: Anyone with the link can use your app without an account.

entries.title: Sign in to your app as any of its people
entries.body: One tap shows your app as a customer or a member of staff sees it.

entries.title: Change a saved value in place
entries.body: Open what your app saved and correct one value without asking for a change.

entries.title: Download your app's code
entries.body: Your app is yours. Take its code with you at any time.

entries.title: More design choices
entries.body: Dashed or dotted borders, capitals or small letters, picture shapes, and text cut to a set number of lines.

entries.title: Try every design change on its own copy first
entries.body: Design changes wait on a copy of your app until you keep them.

entries.title: A simpler home page and pricing page
entries.body: Both now get to the point, work with the keyboard and read well in dark mode.

entries.title: Start a new app by saying what it is for
entries.body: Write one sentence, or start from a sketch, a screenshot or a ready-made app.

entries.title: Point at a part of your app and change how it looks
entries.body: Colours, space, words, pictures, links and motion change at once. No AI is used.

entries.title: Undo and redo any design change
entries.body: Each step back or forward shows at once, removed parts included.

entries.title: See your changed screen as a phone, a tablet and a computer
entries.body: We also tell you when words are too faint to read or when keyboard users cannot see what is selected.

entries.title: Every change shows how it is known to work
entries.body: One word says how well a change was checked, with the story of each step beside it.

entries.title: Only questions worth your time
entries.body: We ask you only when the answer matters, say why, and keep your answer as a decision you can change later.

entries.title: Know what a change may affect before you ask
entries.body: Pick a part, and we name the other parts a change to it may reach.

entries.title: What changed since you last looked
entries.body: Your app's page lists what is new since your last visit, and which changes are not online yet.

entries.title: Read the emails your app sends
entries.body: While you try your app, every email it sends shows up for you instead of going out.

entries.title: Open the rows and files your app saved
entries.body: Read what your app stored, such as uploads and records, and start it fresh when you want.

entries.title: Connect payments and email by pasting your keys
entries.body: Paste in the key from a payment or email service we support, and your app can take payments and send email.

entries.title: Fix problems from the notice that tells you
entries.body: When your app runs into a problem, the notice offers a fix in one click.

entries.title: Security problems in your app's building blocks
entries.body: We tell you when a part your app is built on has a known serious security problem.

entries.title: Pick a look when you start
entries.body: Each new app starts in one of four looks, and you can change it any time.
